blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More Filipinos were satisfied with Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team than the House prosecution during her Senate impeachment trial, a survey from the Social Weather Stations (SWS) said on Wednesday. The survey was fielded among 1,500 Filipino adults, aged 18 and above, nationwide using face-to-face interviews. It found that 47 percent of Filipinos were satisfied with Duterte’s lawyers in handling the Senate impeachment proceedings, while 24 percent were dissatisfied. Its net satisfaction score is at +23. Around 22 percent expressed satisfaction, while 25 percent were somewhat satisfied, 15 percent were somewhat dissatisfied, 9 percent were very dissatisfied, […]...
